subject: Choosing bedroom colours and finishes
hook: Light and airy, or dark and cosy?
ig:
Light and airy, or dark and cosy? It's the biggest colour decision in any bedroom, and both answers can be right.

A: Matt white
Reflects light, so it helps small or north-facing bedrooms feel bigger. Works with almost any wall colour. The trade-off: without thoughtful handles or a bit of texture, a full wall of white can look a little plain.

B: Charcoal
Wraps the room in a calm, cocooning feel and hides the odd scuff. Looks rich with antique gold handles. The trade-off: in a small room with little daylight, it can make the walls feel closer.

A useful test: think about when you use the room most. If it's mostly evenings with lamps on, darker finishes often feel better than you'd expect.

Which would you go for? Comment A or B, plus whether your bedroom faces north or south. We'll reply with what tends to work.
